name: subastas-audit-harness
description: Dependency island for the hydra-418 measurement harness. Kept OUT of the app's package.json on purpose: playwright is a ~200MB browser-driving dev dependency that the production image must never install, and the app's node_modules is a symlink shared across every worktree in this repo family — adding to it would push a heavyweight dep onto builds that have nothing to do with measurement. Node resolves from the importing FILE upward, so `scripts/audit/node_modules` is found by these .mjs files and by nothing else. Install with: npm install --prefix scripts/audit
